_doc: Canonical car-photo registry (season-keyed: constructor -> season -> photos). A photo renders publicly only when approvedForPublicUse is true. Derivatives (background removal, crop, resize) keep the ORIGINAL photographer, licence and attribution; the derivative never carries a PropBetEdge copyright. Rights proof = the Commons file page + licence metadata + SHA-1 of the downloaded original.

carModelSource.use: car name only (fact); no prose or images reused

photos.attribution: Photo: Liauzh, CC BY 4.0 · background removed
photos.rightsNotes: CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use and adaptation with attribution and an indication of changes. No Commons restriction templates on the file. Sponsor marks are part of the photographed livery and are not removed or altered; trademarks are not licensed to PropBetEdge and are shown only as they appear on the car.
photos.approvalNote: Owner approved 2026-10-02 as the first live real-car constructor page (/teams/mercedes).
